headline: Nintendo Reports Lower Quarterly Net Profit as Switch 2 Sales Slow
summary: Japanese gaming giant Nintendo reported a drop in quarterly net profit as unit sales for its Switch 2 console slowed, while maintaining its full-year forecasts.
why: Nintendo is a leading global video game and hardware manufacturer whose financial results offer insight into consumer discretionary spending trends.
